Hi Patrícia, it is Karen. I saw the Brightwave survey. A seven after a difficult quarter is a good result, so do not worry about the number. Worry about the comment. When a customer writes mixed feedback, most people answer only the praise, because it feels nice. Please do the opposite. Start with the complaint, even though it is uncomfortable. Say what happened in one sentence, without excuses. Then say what you have changed. Only at the end, thank him for the kind words. And one more thing: answer on the phone first, and send the email after the call. Although an email is faster, a voice shows that you really care. Call me after you speak to Daniel.

Hi Patrícia, it is Arjun. A quick update on your request from the Brightwave survey. You asked for a warning before the customer sees a problem. Good news: it is done. From tonight, if the nightly sync is not finished by five in the morning, the system sends an alert to you and to our support team. That gives you two hours before their stores open. There is one drawback, though. The alert will sometimes arrive when the sync is only slow, not broken. In spite of that, I think a few false alarms are better than another angry morning. If you agree, I will turn it on for your other accounts next week.
